fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Dade County school funding and retrenchment, Miami budget concerns and proposed reductions in downtown street lighting, and local civic affairs including the Miami Chamber of Commerce and city industrial/tourist promotion. Coverage also discusses police discipline under new leadership, public health concerns about milk testing and “diseased milk,” and Prohibition-era liquor quality and enforcement in Miami Beach courts. Additional local-interest pieces mention an aquarium at the city docks, entertainment/nightlife listings and society notes, and references to Elks activities and convention visitors.
